title: Academic misconduct panel - respond in 24 hours
scenario: An email says a plagiarism report has been filed against you and you must log in to a portal within 24 hours to submit your defense or be marked as non-responsive.

answers.A: Log in through the link right away to respond in time.
answers.B: Check the sender's address and confirm through your official student email or advisor before clicking anything.
answers.C: Log in and enter your student credentials without checking the link first.

explanation: Academic misconduct processes are handled through your university's own systems and known contacts, not a rushed 24-hour email with an external portal link.
proTip: A real accusation survives you checking it through a channel you already trust.
